company.text: Ansana delivers a **smart sterilization platform** that combines a sensor‑rich device with data‑modules for real‑time tracking, parametric release and workflow optimisation. The technology promises improved patient safety, cost efficiency and sustainability by eliminating consumables. Headquartered in Maastricht with a US office in Bear, DE, Ansana is actively expanding in the US, highlighted by its participation in the Texas Medical Center’s Biobridge accelerator. The target customers are hospital sterile processing departments and surgical teams that need end‑to‑end instrument reprocessing control. Recent news (Oct 2026) confirms the US accelerator win; earlier 2026 events show active engagement at AHRMM and HSPA congresses. No public financing data is disclosed.
